summary: This House Resolution honors the Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Incorporated, Chi Chapter, on its centennial anniversary, recognizing its contributions to sisterhood, scholarship, and service, and requests that an enrolled copy of the resolution be transmitted to the chapter.

scores.thoughts: This resolution honors a sorority chapter at Talladega College, an HBCU, recognizing its commitment to academic excellence and leadership. While it mentions education, it does not propose any spending changes or policy shifts related to public schools, making its impact on the topic negligible.
